哪个女孩儿是马丽？ (Nǎge nǚháir shì Mǎ Lì?) - Which girl is Ma Li?

喜欢小红的人多不多？她怎么样？ (Xǐhuan Xiǎo Hóng de rén duō bu duō? Tā zěnmeyàng?) - Are there many people who like Xiaohong? What is she like?
小刚和小丽打算买什么？ (Xiǎo Gāng hé Xiǎo Lì dǎsuàn mǎi shénme?) - What do Xiaogang and Xiaoli plan to buy?
小刚和小丽回家后打算做什么？ (Xiǎo Gāng hé Xiǎo Lì huí jiā hòu dǎsuàn zuò shénme?) - What do Xiaogang and Xiaoli plan to do after getting home?
客人要找谁？她怎么样？ (Kèrén yào zhǎo shéi? Tā zěnmeyàng?) - Who does the guest want to find? What is she like?
休息一下再爬吧。 (Xiūxi yíxià zài pá ba.) - Rest a while and then climb again.
山太高了，多累啊。 (Shān tài gāo le, duō lèi a.) - The mountain is too high; how tiring!
今天天气真不好！ (Jīntiān tiānqì zhēn bù hǎo!) - The weather is really bad today!
因为我写作业的时候很认真。 (Yīnwèi wǒ xiě zuòyè de shíhou hěn rènzhēn.) - Because I am very conscientious when I do my homework.
我不认真吗？ (Wǒ bù rènzhēn ma?) - Am I not conscientious?
那张照片是什么时候照的？ (Nà zhāng zhàopiàn shì shénme shíhou zhào de?) - When was that photo taken?
女孩 (nǚhái) - girl (word game: 女 + 孩子)
一定 (yídìng, definitely)
一定能参加，一点儿影响也没有。 (Yídìng néng cānjiā, yìdiǎnr yǐngxiǎng yě méiyǒu.) - Definitely, there is no effect at all.
影响 (yǐngxiǎng, influence)
Exercise: Read Phrases & Sentences Aloud (Unit 9)

我一定不会变胖。 (Wǒ yídìng bú huì biàn pàng.) - I definitely won't get fat.
他影响了我。 (Tā yǐngxiǎng le wǒ.) - He influenced me.
一点儿影响也没有。 (Yìdiǎnr yǐngxiǎng yě méiyǒu.) - There is no effect at all.

你给我的那本书我看完了。 (Nǐ gěi wǒ de nà běn shū wǒ kàn wán le.) - I have finished reading the book you gave me.

那我也开始跑步吧。 (Nà wǒ yě kāishǐ pǎobù ba.) - Then I'll start running too.

Text 1: 在家 (At home)
客人就要来了，你怎么还不打扫房间啊？ (Kèrén jiù yào lái le, nǐ zěnme hái bù dǎsǎo fángjiān a?) - The guests are about to arrive, why haven't you cleaned the room yet?

别着急，我让孩子们打扫呢，客人来的时候，他们会把房间打扫干净。 (Bié zháojí, wǒ ràng háizimen dǎsǎo ne, kèrén lái de shíhou, tāmen huì bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo gānjìng.) - Don't worry, I'm having the children clean it; when the guests come, they will have the room cleaned.
那你也不能看电视啊。 (Nà nǐ yě bù néng kàn diànshì a.) - Then you shouldn't be watching TV either.
你让我做什么？ (Nǐ ràng wǒ zuò shénme?) - What do you want me to do?
太热了，我还是先把空调打开吧。 (Tài rè le, wǒ háishi xiān bǎ kōngtiáo dǎ kāi ba.) - It's too hot, I'd better turn on the air conditioning first.
打扫 (dǎsǎo, to clean/sweep)
干净 (gānjìng, clean)
我把衣服洗干净了。 (Wǒ bǎ yīfu xǐ gānjìng le.) - I have washed the clothes clean.
你怎么还不打扫房间啊？ (Nǐ zěnme hái bù dǎsǎo fángjiān a?) - Why haven't you cleaned the room yet?
他们会把房间打扫干净。 (Tāmen huì bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo gānjìng.) - They will clean the room until it is clean.
都洗干净了吗？ (Dōu xǐ gānjìng le ma?) - Are they all washed clean?
打扫 (dǎsǎo) - to clean, to sweep [v.; L14]
干净 (gānjìng) - clean [adj.; L14]
Text 3: 在休息室 (In the lounge)
现在用电脑上网真方便啊！ (Xiànzài yòng diànnǎo shàng wǎng zhēn fāngbiàn a!) - It's really convenient to go online with a computer now!

是啊，除了看新闻，人们还可以在网上听歌、看电影、买东西。 (Shì a, chúle kàn xīnwén, rénmen hái kěyǐ zài wǎngshang tīng gē, kàn diànyǐng, mǎi dōngxi.) - Yes, besides reading the news, people can also listen to songs, watch movies and shop online.
对了，你从网上买的那件衣服呢？ (Duìle, nǐ cóng wǎngshang mǎi de nà jiàn yīfu ne?) - By the way, where is the piece of clothing you bought online?
怎么没见你穿？ (Zěnme méi jiàn nǐ chuān?) - Why haven't I seen you wearing it?
那件衣服我穿着有点儿小，给我弟弟了。 (Nà jiàn yīfu wǒ chuānzhe yǒudiǎnr xiǎo, gěi wǒ dìdi le.) - That piece of clothing was a bit small for me, so I gave it to my younger brother.
他满意吗？ (Tā mǎnyì ma?) - Is he satisfied?
上网 (shàng wǎng, to surf the Internet)
新闻 (xīnwén, news)
上网除了看新闻，还可以听音乐。 (Shàng wǎng chúle kàn xīnwén, hái kěyǐ tīng yīnyuè.) - Besides reading the news, going online also lets you listen to music.
刚才电视上的那条新闻真有意思！ (Gāngcái diànshì shang de nà tiáo xīnwén zhēn yǒu yìsi!) - The news item on TV just now was really interesting!
现在用电脑上网真方便啊！ (Xiànzài yòng diànnǎo shàng wǎng zhēn fāngbiàn a!) - It's really convenient to go online with a computer now!
大家可以上网做什么？ (Dàjiā kěyǐ shàng wǎng zuò shénme?) - What can people do online?
新闻 (xīnwén) - news [n.; L15]
人 (rén) "human, person"

Dialogue: 在咖啡馆儿 In a Coffee House
电视 diànshì (television)
昨天上午你在做什么呢？ (Zuótiān shàngwǔ nǐ zài zuò shénme ne?) - What were you doing yesterday morning?
我在家看电视呢。 (Wǒ zài jiā kàn diànshì ne.) - I was watching TV at home.
你喜欢看电视吗？ (Nǐ xǐhuan kàn diànshì ma?) - Do you like watching TV?
我不喜欢看电视，我喜欢看电影。 (Wǒ bù xǐhuan kàn diànshì, wǒ xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng.) - I don't like watching TV; I like seeing movies.
上午 shàngwǔ (morning, before noon)
喜欢 xǐhuan (to like, to be fond of)
他们都喜欢看电视吗？ (Tāmen dōu xǐhuan kàn diànshì ma?) - Do they all like watching TV?
电视 (diànshì) - television (n., Lesson 13)
看电视 (kàn diànshì) - to watch TV
好啊。 (Hǎo a.) - Sure.
好啊！ (Hǎo a!) - Great!
Dialogue 3: 在超市门口 (At the entrance of a supermarket)
我有点儿饿了，我们进超市买点儿东西吧。 (Wǒ yǒudiǎnr è le, wǒmen jìn chāoshì mǎi diǎnr dōngxi ba.) - I'm a bit hungry; let's go into the supermarket and buy something.

好啊，这家超市的蛋糕又便宜又好吃，一块只要2.99元。 (Hǎo a, zhè jiā chāoshì de dàngāo yòu piányi yòu hǎochī, yí kuàir zhǐ yào èr diǎn jiǔ jiǔ yuán.) - OK; the cakes in this supermarket are both cheap and tasty - only 2.99 yuan a piece.
我们买两块，回家吃着蛋糕看电视，怎么样？ (Wǒmen mǎi liǎng kuàir, huí jiā chīzhe dàngāo kàn diànshì, zěnmeyàng?) - Let's buy two pieces and eat cake while watching TV at home - how about that?
好啊，我再去买一些喝的。 (Hǎo a, wǒ zài qù mǎi yìxiē hē de.) - OK, I'll go and buy something to drink too.
喝着咖啡吃蛋糕，太好了！ (Hēzhe kāfēi chī dàngāo, tài hǎo le!) - Eating cake while drinking coffee - great!
超市 chāoshì (supermarket)
蛋糕 dàngāo (cake)
饿 è (hungry)
好啊。 (Hǎo a.) - Good.
蛋糕 (dàngāo) - cake [n.; L4]

Dialogue: 在运动场 (On the Playground)
听说你有女朋友了？ (Tīngshuō nǐ yǒu nǚpéngyou le?) - I heard you have a girlfriend now?
我认识她吗？ (Wǒ rènshi tā ma?) - Do I know her?
她不是有男朋友吗？ (Tā bú shì yǒu nánpéngyou ma?) - She's already got a boyfriend, hasn't she?
那个已经是她的前男友了。 (Nàge yǐjīng shì tā de qián nányǒu le.) - That's her ex now.
Grammar: The Rhetorical Question "不是……吗"
不是说今天有雨吗？怎么没下？ (Búshì shuō jīntiān yǒu yǔ ma? Zěnme méi xià?) - Didn't they say it would rain today? Why hasn't it rained?
你不是北京人吗？怎么不会说北京话？ (Nǐ búshì Běijīng rén ma? Zěnme bú huì shuō Běijīng huà?) - Aren't you from Beijing? Why can't you speak the Beijing dialect?
（她是你的女朋友？）她不是有男朋友了吗？ ((Tā shì nǐ de nǚpéngyou?) Tā búshì yǒu nánpéngyou le ma?) - (Is she your girlfriend?) Doesn't she already have a boyfriend?
路口 lùkǒu (crossing, crossroads)
从这儿一直往前走，到了前面的路口再往右走。 (Cóng zhèr yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, dàole qiánmiàn de lùkǒu zài wǎng yòu zǒu.) - Walk straight ahead from here and turn right at the first crossing.
往 wǎng (to, towards)
一直 yìzhí (straight, all along)
从这儿往前走，就是我们学校。 (Cóng zhèr wǎng qián zǒu, jiù shì wǒmen xuéxiào.) - Go forward from here and you will reach our school.
你看，往左走是医院，往右走是银行。 (Nǐ kàn, wǎng zuǒ zǒu shì yīyuàn, wǎng yòu zǒu shì yínháng.) - Look, go left and it is the hospital; go right and it is the bank.
从这儿一直往前走，到了前面的路口再往右走。 (Cóng zhèr yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, dàole qiánmiàn de lùkǒu zài wǎng yòu zǒu.) - Walk straight ahead from here and turn right at the crossing ahead.
Grammar: The Preposition "往"

我没（有）看过那个电影。 (Wǒ méi(yǒu) kànguo nàge diànyǐng.) - I have not seen that movie.
我没（有）去过中国。 (Wǒ méi(yǒu) qùguo Zhōngguó.) - I have not been to China.

Text 3: Talking about the Travel Plan (聊旅游计划)
下个月我去旅游，你能跟我一起去吗？ (Xià ge yuè wǒ qù lǚyóu, nǐ néng gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù ma?) - I'm going traveling next month; can you go with me?
我还没想好呢。 (Wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo ne.) - I haven't decided yet.
你觉得哪儿最好玩儿？ (Nǐ juéde nǎr zuì hǎowánr?) - Where do you think is the most fun?
南方啊，我们去年就是这个时候去的。 (Nánfāng a, wǒmen qùnián jiù shì zhège shíhou qù de.) - The south; we went at just this time last year.
南方太热了，北方好一些，不冷也不热。 (Nánfāng tài rè le, běifāng hǎo yìxiē, bù lěng yě bú rè.) - The south is too hot; the north is a bit better, neither cold nor hot.
北方 (běifāng) - north, northern part
南(方) (nán fāng) - south, southern part

Text 4: Preparing for Their Trip (准备去旅游)
水果、面包、茶都准备好了， (Shuǐguǒ, miànbāo, chá dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le,) - The fruit, bread and tea are all ready,
我们还带什么？ (Wǒmen hái dài shénme?) - what else shall we bring?
手机、电脑、地图，一个也不能少。 (Shǒujī, diànnǎo, dìtú, yí ge yě bù néng shǎo.) - Mobile phone, computer, map: not a single one can be left out.
这些我昨天下午就准备好了。 (Zhèxiē wǒ zuótiān xiàwǔ jiù zhǔnbèi hǎo le.) - I got all these ready yesterday afternoon.
再多带几件衣服吧。 (Zài duō dài jǐ jiàn yīfu ba.) - Bring a few more pieces of clothing.
我们是去旅游，不是搬家，还是少带一些吧。 (Wǒmen shì qù lǚyóu, bú shì bān jiā, háishi shǎo dài yìxiē ba.) - We're going traveling, not moving house; we'd better bring less.
搬 (bān) - to move, to carry
带 (dài) - to take along, to bring
地图 (dìtú) - map
面包 (miànbāo) - bread

这句话告诉我们，开始做事情的时候遇到困难是正常的，不要因此而放弃，要坚持下去，以后会越做越容易，越来越好。 (Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen, kāishǐ zuò shìqing de shíhou yùdào kùnnan shì zhèngcháng de, bú yào yīncǐ ér fàngqì, yào jiānchí xiàqu, yǐhòu huì yuè zuò yuè róngyì, yuè lái yuè hǎo.) - This saying tells us that meeting difficulties at the start is normal; do not give up because of them but persevere, and it will get easier and better.
Common Saying: 一步走错步步错 (One wrong move makes all moves wrong)
一步走错步步错。 (Yí bù zǒucuò bùbù cuò.) - One wrong move makes all moves wrong.

"一步走错步步错"的意思是，下棋的时候，如果有一步走错了，那么以后的每一步都是错的。 ("Yí bù zǒucuò bùbù cuò" de yìsi shì, xià qí de shíhou, rúguǒ yǒu yí bù zǒucuò le, nàme yǐhòu de měi yí bù dōu shì cuò de.) - It means that in a chess game, if one move is wrong, then every later move will be wrong too.

这句话用来比喻如果我们开始时做了一个错误的决定，那么以后的每一次决定都会是错的。 (Zhè jù huà yònglái bǐyù rúguǒ wǒmen kāishǐ shí zuòle yí ge cuòwù de juédìng, nàme yǐhòu de měi yí cì juédìng dōu huì shì cuò de.) - Metaphorically, it means that if we make a wrong decision at the start, every decision after it will be wrong.

这句话告诉我们，做事情的时候每一步都要谨慎，避免出现错误，尤其是开始的时候。 (Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen, zuò shìqing de shíhou měi yí bù dōu yào jǐnshèn, bìmiǎn chūxiàn cuòwù, yóuqí shì kāishǐ de shíhou.) - This saying tells us to be prudent at every step, to avoid mistakes, especially at the beginning.
Common Saying: 站得高，看得远 (The higher you stand, the farther you'll see)
站得高，看得远。 (Zhàn de gāo, kàn de yuǎn.) - The higher you stand, the farther you'll see.

"站得高，看得远"的意思是，站在高的地方，就能看到更远的地方。 ("Zhàn de gāo, kàn de yuǎn" de yìsi shì, zhàn zài gāo de dìfang, jiù néng kàndào gèng yuǎn de dìfang.) - It means that standing in a high place, you can see farther places.

这句话也用来比喻不能只从一个方面看问题，多考虑几个方面，才能更加全面。 (Zhè jù huà yě yònglái bǐyù bù néng zhǐ cóng yí ge fāngmiàn kàn wèntí, duō kǎolǜ jǐ ge fāngmiàn, cáinéng gèngjiā quánmiàn.) - It is also used metaphorically: do not view a problem from one aspect only; consider several aspects to be more comprehensive.
Common Saying: 三人行，必有我师 (there must be one I can learn from)
三人行，必有我师。 (Sān rén xíng, bì yǒu wǒ shī.) - When three people walk together, there must be one I can learn from.

这句话用来比喻别人身上可能有我们没有的优点，我们要学习别人身上的优点。 (Zhè jù huà yòng lái bǐyù biérén shēn shang kěnéng yǒu wǒmen méiyǒu de yōudiǎn, wǒmen yào xuéxí biérén shēn shang de yōudiǎn.) - This saying is used to mean that others may have merits we lack, and we should learn from the merits of others.

“五十步笑百步”这句话来源于中国古代的一个故事。 ("Wǔshí bù xiào bǎi bù" zhè jù huà láiyuán yú Zhōngguó gǔdài de yí gè gùshi.) - The saying "Wǔshí bù xiào bǎi bù" originates from a story of ancient China.

从前有两个士兵，打仗失败往回跑，一个人跑了五十步，另一个跑了一百步，跑了五十步的就笑话跑了一百步的，说他胆小。 (Cóngqián yǒu liǎng gè shìbīng, dǎzhàng shībài wǎng huí pǎo, yí gè rén pǎole wǔshí bù, lìng yí gè pǎole yìbǎi bù, pǎole wǔshí bù de jiù xiàohua pǎole yìbǎi bù de, shuō tā dǎnxiǎo.) - Once there were two soldiers who fled from a lost battle; one ran 50 steps, the other 100, and the one who ran 50 steps laughed at the one who ran 100, saying he was a coward.
其实两人都是逃跑，只是跑得远近不同。 (Qíshí liǎng rén dōu shì táopǎo, zhǐshì pǎo de yuǎn jìn bù tóng.) - In fact both were running away; the only difference was how far they ran.

这句话用来批评那些跟别人有一样的缺点，却因程度轻而笑话别人的人。 (Zhè jù huà yònglái pīpíng nàxiē gēn biérén yǒu yíyàng de quēdiǎn, què yīn chéngdù qīng ér xiàohua biérén de rén.) - This saying is used to criticize people who have the same fault as others but laugh at them because theirs is milder.

“药到病除”的意思是吃了药，病马上就好了，形容医生的医术很好，用药恰到好处。 ("Yàodào bìngchú" de yìsi shì chīle yào, bìng mǎshàng jiù hǎo le, xíngróng yīshēng de yīshù hěn hǎo, yòng yào qiàdào hǎochù.) - "药到病除" means that as soon as medicine is taken the disease is cured, describing a skilful doctor who prescribes just the right medicine.

现在也比喻人能够找到问题的关键，马上解决问题。 (Xiànzài yě bǐyù rén nénggòu zhǎodào wèntí de guānjiàn, mǎshàng jiějué wèntí.) - Now it is also a metaphor for one's ability to find the crux of a problem and solve it immediately.
喜欢喝咖啡了。 (Xǐhuan hē kāfēi le.) - (I) like drinking coffee now.
万事开头难。 (Wàn shì kāitóu nán.) - The first step is always the hardest.
"万事开头难"的意思是，做什么事情都是开始的时候比较难。 ("Wàn shì kāitóu nán" de yìsi shì, zuò shénme shìqing dōu shì kāishǐ de shíhou bǐjiào nán.) - "万事开头难" means that whatever one does, it is harder at the start.
